newsitem.title: FINLAND: VALTAMERI TO DISPOSE OF TRADING, AEROSPACE.
newsitem.headline: VALTAMERI TO DISPOSE OF TRADING, AEROSPACE.

text.p: Finnish environmetal technology and trading group Valtameri said on Wednesday it planned to dispose of its trading and aerospace operations, and to concentrate its environmental technology operations into a separate unit.

"Valtameri's board has decided to take action to dispose the trading and aerospace technology businesses and to concentrate the environmental technology operations into a separate subsidiary," Valtameri said in a statement.
"These actions will create opportunities to boost Valtameri's earnings in the long term," it said.
